ValidationRule.description: CCCAP-2720 : To restrict Case Name being edited from List view in Case tab
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( Name ), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE( Name ))), PRIORVALUE( Name ) <> "RECORD_FROM_CASE_FLOW", NOT (Bypass_CaseName_ValidationRule__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case Name can not be changed after creation
